title: Lattice offers Lattice Prompt for free, supporting FPGA design with natural language
excerpt: On September 16, 2026, Lattice announced free availability of its AI design assistance tool, Lattice Prompt. We explain FPGA basics, the roles of Radiant and MCP, which steps it can support, what is free, and the limits of the maker's claim of a 10x or greater productivity gain.
